intro: Crusader's Outpost is a fortified scout tower manned by the Scarlet Crusade in western Tirisfal Glades. Situated adjacent to the Solliden Farmstead, it serves as the Crusade's westernmost position in all of Lordaeron. Its perilous distance from the main Scarlet bastions leaves its garrison isolated in the heart of hostile Forsaken territory.

p: Perched inside the western Tirisfal hills just north of Deathknell, this stone tower represents the farthest reach of the Scarlet Crusade's power in Lordaeron. The garrison stationed here works in tandem with the surviving human laborers of the nearby Solliden Farmstead, attempting to hold back the encroaching undead. From the top of the tower, lookouts keep watch over the surrounding pumpkin fields and forest paths, vigilant against both roaming Scourge fiends and patrols from the Undercity.

Holding the western frontier carries extreme risk. Cut off from their primary strongholds in the Scarlet Monastery and far to the east in Tyr's Hand, the crusaders at this outpost cannot expect swift reinforcements should an attack breach the palisade. Any siege by the Forsaken forces massing across Tirisfal means either holding the tower on their own or facing total annihilation before help can ever arrive.
